_what: How the Posts screen (posts-screen.tsx) shows a person's posts. `reaches` words show who a post contacts first and where each was found (src/social-posts.mjs invariant 7). `statuses` are a post's states (src/social-posts.mjs) in the order the list sections run, each with its section name and badge tone; a status not listed shows under its own word. `destination_states` are the tones of each place's state. `actions` are what a person can press on a post: `id` is the verb the Worker takes (src/work-posts.mjs), `when` the statuses it is offered in, `done` the words shown when the answer says nothing. `write` is what the new-post panel says (src/workspace/new-post.tsx, on Posts and the posting calendar), `places` what it says about where a post goes (`connect_screen` is the screen its Connect opens), `empty` what Posts says with no post yet. `ask_ai` names the jobs the screen hands the person's AI (`job_id`, a src/queued-work.json row, which holds its words; `context`, what the press sends besides the post it is on): drafting a first post, and fixing a post that is not ready. `media_height` is the height of the box an opened post's video, picture or sound is drawn in (the shared file preview fits the file inside it).
